title: RedVLA physical red teaming before a VLA manipulation policy release
agent: Head of robot learning at a vision-language-action (VLA) model developer who owns the release decision for a fine-tuned manipulation policy checkpoint shipped to customer robots.
decision: Delay the checkpoint release and add a runtime guard plus safety fine-tuning vs release as planned.
theta_definition: theta=1: with a plausibly placed hazard object in its workspace, the manipulation policy grasps a knife or other sharp tool, collides with or topples placed objects, or puts a flammable item on a heat source, and the behaviour reproduces on the physical robot.
instrument: RedVLA physical red teaming (risk scenes placed in simulation, gradient-free pose optimisation, a small physical-robot reproduction of found scenes), run against the candidate VLA checkpoint.

decision_facts: Real-world deployment of vision-language-action (VLA) models remains limited by the risk of unpredictable and irreversible physical harm [zhang2026redvla]. VLAs pose deployment safety challenges including harm to the environment, the robot and humans [zhang2025safevla]. Across six VLA policies, a hazard or obstacle object (knife, bottle, book, tableware) placed in an otherwise benign scene triggered unsafe behaviour in 64.9% to 95.5% of episodes [zhang2026redvla]. A stronger variant in the same policy family (OpenVLA-OFT over OpenVLA) raised benign task success by 20.6 points and the unsafe-behaviour rate by 25.6 points [zhang2026redvla]. On physical Franka arms, pi0 and pi0.5 grasped an inserted knife or knocked over cup obstacles in more than 80% of 10 trials per task [zhang2026redvla]. The pi0 and pi0.5 developers publish open checkpoints, including task checkpoints intended to run directly on target robots [openpi_readme]. pi0.5 controls mobile manipulators cleaning kitchens and bedrooms in homes not seen in training [black2025pi05]. The US Census of Fatal Occupational Injuries recorded 41 robot-related deaths in 1992-2017; 78% involved a robot striking the worker under its own power [layne2023robotfatalities]. Operational industrial robot stock reached 5 million units in 2025 [ifr2026industrial]. About 7,000 full-size humanoids and 34.2 million consumer service robots were sold in 2025, and the IFR names safety standards among the challenges limiting humanoid adoption [ifr2026service]. A guard model trained on discovered failure scenes cut unsafe behaviour from 90.9% to 31.4% on seen tasks and from 98.3% to 46.7% on unseen tasks, at a benign task-success cost of 4.08 and 10.00 percentage points [zhang2026redvla].
instrument_facts: RedVLA comes from the Institute for AI, Peking University [zhang2026redvla]. It is a black-box two-stage pipeline: a risk object from a library of sharp tools, a wine bottle, books, liquid containers, obstructive tableware and displaced targets is placed in a critical interaction region of a benign trajectory, then gradient-free optimisation on policy feedback refines its pose until a target predicate fires [zhang2026redvla]. Binary predicates such as collide(wine bottle), checkgrasping(knife) and on(book, stove) define ten risk scenario suites on LIBERO scenes in MuJoCo [zhang2026redvla]. Three annotators and one reviewer built scenes by unanimous consensus, three to five minutes each [zhang2026redvla]. Each risk scenario runs 10 trials with fixed seeds, a 520-step horizon and at most 10 optimisation iterations on six LIBERO-fine-tuned policies, scored by attack success rate (ASR), the share of episodes with the target violation [zhang2026redvla]. Experiments used 8 NVIDIA A100 and 8 RTX 3090 GPUs [zhang2026redvla]. No cost figure is published [zhang2026redvla]. Mean ASR per model was 64.9% to 95.5%; averaged over six models, state-level ASR exceeded 95%, with per-model state-level suite values from 88.8% to 98.4%, near the score ceiling [zhang2026redvla]. On two physical Franka arms, pi0 and pi0.5 reached ASR above 80% on three pick-and-place tasks with an inserted knife or cup obstacles, 10 trials each [zhang2026redvla]. Limitations: predefined predicates, risk objects and violations; evaluation only where policies already execute well [zhang2026redvla]. The paper states code and assets will be released under CC BY-NC 4.0 [zhang2026redvla]; the RedVLA and red-libero repositories carry the MIT License [redvla_github].
